With Truecaller, you can identify and block spam calls, search unknown numbers, and help protect your family with Family Protection.
With Truecaller Travel eSIM, you can now stay connected worldwide with seamless mobile data while traveling.

Trusted by over 500 million users, Truecaller uses smart spam detection to help protect you from unwanted calls, scams, and fraud while keeping your communication safe and under control.

CALLER ID & SPAM BLOCKING
• A new Caller ID experience on iPhone with iOS 18.2 and above
• Automatically identify spam, fraud, scam, and robocalls before you pick up
• View and search previously identified calls directly in the Phone app
• Block unwanted callers and reduce spam calls
• Enable spam identification via Settings > Apps > Phone > Call Blocking & Identification
• A paid subscription is required to access this feature

TRUECALLER FAMILY PLAN: PROTECT YOUR LOVED ONES
Share Truecaller Premium with your family and help keep your loved ones protected from spam, scam, and fraud calls.

• Add up to 4 family members to your plan
• Share Premium benefits with your family
• Help your loved ones identify spam and fraud calls
• Keep your family safer from unwanted callers
• One subscription for the whole family

TRUECALLER eSIM: GLOBAL DATA FOR TRAVEL
Stay connected worldwide with Truecaller eSIM — fast, secure, and reliable mobile data wherever you travel.

• Coverage in 155 countries across Europe, Americas, Asia, and more
• Instant activation — no physical SIM required
• Affordable prepaid plans with transparent pricing
• No hidden roaming fees or unexpected charges
• Flexible data options for any trip duration
• Secure, stable connectivity wherever you go

Available for users from selected markets:
Italy, Sweden, Spain, France, Germany, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Netherlands, Belgium, Ireland, Austria, Finland, Czech Rep., Denmark, Hungary, United States, United Kingdom, Australia, Canada, New Zealand, Switzerland, Norway, Chile, Indonesia, Malaysia, South Africa, Egypt, Nigeria

IDENTIFY ANY NUMBER
• Search any phone number to find the name and relevant information
• Works for both local and international numbers
• Easily search numbers from your call history via share extension

TRUECALLER PREMIUM: UPGRADE YOUR EXPERIENCE
• Automatically identify and block spam calls
• Remove all ads
• Unlimited number lookups
• See who viewed your profile
• Family Plan for up to 4 members
• Premium badge on your profile
• Auto-renewing subscription with a free trial for new users

Truecaller respects your privacy. Your phonebook is never made searchable or public.

Terms of use: https://www.truecaller.com/terms-of-service
Please note: Payment for auto-renewing subscriptions will be charged to your iTunes account upon confirmation. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your Account Settings.
